I6-C must wait for Author corrections and independent re-review.** This PR adds review evidence only; product code, existing assertions, Accepted ADRs, historical evidence, both Transfer fences and the existing stack are unchanged.

[REPORT](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-independent-20261023/REPORT.md) · [findings.json](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-independent-20261023/findings.json) · [R02–R09 / V01–V09 / T01–T27 matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-independent-20261023/MATRIX.md) · [lossless evidence inventory](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-independent-20261023/TRANSPORT.json)

| Finding | Reproduced contract failure | Required correction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **I6B-IR-M01 Medium** | Already validated 1,001-row Context, empty selections and max_work 0/1/17 still execute 1,501 embedded parses / 314,392 characters and charge 26,041 work before refusal. Three contract assertions fail in source and both wheels. Global hard caps still terminate. | Constrain preliminary parsing/traversal/allocation by remaining cumulative work before doing it; retain truthful charges and whole completed units. |
| **I6B-IR-M02 Medium** | Selection duplicate/permutation changes the received dictionary hash, but pre-checksum normalization accepts the stale digest. Thirty required-refusal assertions fail in source and both wheels. Independently reproduced in #149 v4; inherited mechanism, newly frozen v5 R03 contract unmet. | Verify the bounded received dictionary excluding only digest_sha256 before normalization, or provide explicitly reviewed canonicality-refusal/outcome mapping. No authority/authentication bypass is claimed. |

Direct base is #151's actual branch **`impl/adr0031-i6b-generalized-wire`**, HEAD `ef787a5ff8b13f118d6bf5107c7338f43fde56dc`, tree `a3ed2628a98db134bdc65d13da905f5ddf25e972`. #151 base/merge-base remains #149 `ea43a21fca1dbf8fa6dd1c254b28a96d5dd28d00`. Actual Author test-merge `54464ad` has ordered parents #149/#151 and the feature tree exactly. Published review HEAD **`8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7`**, tree **`455ef25606ee555e4154dd2d14929b41aa4ef50f`**, sole parent #151. All executable inputs remain unchanged.

Independent measured executions (overlapping lanes, never summed):

| Actual invocation | Outcome / exit |
| --- | --- |
| **One complete final-publication source run** | **6,288 unique: 5,989 PASS / 279 FAIL / 20 ERROR, exit 1**, zero skip/xfail/xpass; exact collection/JUnit/journal/typed-phase reconciliation |
| Separate matched 745 diagnostic | 446 PASS / 279 FAIL / 20 ERROR, exit 1; per-node original assertion/exception/refusal/trace comparisons |
| Safety626 + new wire/planner212 | All PASS as subsets of that single full source run, including unchanged I4 217 / I5 29 |
| Independent source scopes | Wire157, V07 separate4, planner28, retained admission237, new19+attributed prior27; separate Author external34: PASS |
| Each independently installed direct / sdist-derived wheel | Separate safety626, Author wire212, independent204, Author external34, V07 separate4: PASS; **new33 contract failures, exit1** |
| Original Access smoke, each minimal installed form | Actual unconnected Exchange export PERMISSION_DENIED, child/pytest exit1; subsequent original assertions UNEXECUTED |

All 6,076 #149 nodes retain outcome/phase; 212 additions pass. The unsuccessful299 set matches: **298 primary failure signatures unchanged, one old three-column carrier now refuses earlier as MALFORMED_ROW**. Its valid seven-column control reaches unconnected PERMISSION_DENIED; neither proves downstream I6-C selection assertions. Whole-file AST equality outside the one fixture assignment and all four original assertion ASTs are verified; the migrated guard parameters reach three/four original assertions. Setup-only P6 fixture scheduling differences and interrupted reviewer-harness attempts remain explicit. No failure is skipped, xfailed, hidden or reassigned from old owner counts.

Actual Python3.12.14 loads SQLite3.53.1. No SQLite installation/build/swap/matrix or safety-floor relaxation. Both new publication-built wheels match all164 members; all160 product files /6,022,477 bytes, metadata, archive/installed RECORD and actual site-packages origins verify. Publication sdist retains all6,349 files plus PKG-INFO. Wheel SHA256 `6b3a865b90673b9626ad120ecf106064d2211657d2d78a68fb6568a52a8aba71`; publication sdist SHA256 `1f83f0ad52deedadde5a43b0ad066e61147df371ee31177564916409108c0422`. Complete inventories/hashes are committed; temporary catalogs/venvs/full >100MB sdist remain outside Git.

Author CI final results:

- [Access 39955068823](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39955068823): **FAILURE**, main2487/279/20 and separate I5 regression2849/279/20. Both unsuccessful299 sets/signatures match fresh source. Its full796MB artifact read was denied403 after connector size limit; complementary observed log chunks recover the original1,948,089-byte receipt SHA256 `0847e6e5445d0d3726bda2020b2438a1b7ee2ac85da4931aced08055fc6199ea` and all121 indexed payloads. No guessed bytes or full-artifact-download claim.
- Final review HEAD CI: [Development run 39963122681](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39963122681) **SUCCESS** on final HEAD `8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7`; both `sqlite-policy` and `offline` pass. Actual in-log receipt independently verified: 86,372 bytes, SHA256 `36a9fc4ccdd1c853bf72f5026d998266f8b7e834583536721143ba4fa2274706`, all21 indexed payloads. Checkout `92a94dbd647362d4286215153076ebfa48b96101` has ordered parents base `ef787a5` / feature `8521158`, effective tree `455ef25606ee555e4154dd2d14929b41aa4ef50f` equal to final feature. Manifest `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`; this is selected Development CI, not hosted full runtime/Release acceptance. Final-HEAD CI receipts are retained at `/workspace/i6b-review-final-ci/` and the linked run, externally binding the immutable evidence commit without a circular self-hash..

776 evidence files include REPORT, findings, matrix, independent probes/reproduction drivers, source/input/artifact hashes, commands/exits, raw logs and JUnit/journals. TRANSPORT inventory SHA256 `498c5880319fd7ecd4ed6ad8fd1db5d113f224606dae123845993b345e52e19a` verifies all775 payload files and lossless original/transport bytes. Required tracked-input and whitespace checks pass.

Normal Provider/Exchange integration, I7/I8, live/benchmark opt-ins, actual stack integration, Release acceptance and fence retirement remain unexecuted or unauthorized. #144/#147/#150 are not integrated. No merge/release/deployment is requested.
